source_origin: Original source was executed as a python here-document through exec_command; it was not originally saved as a test file. The source file now preserves that exact here-document body from the tool call.
stdout_origin: Verbatim JSON stdout preserved from the successful original exec_command tool response; this file was not the original process stdout redirect.
portability: The preserved source intentionally retains its original absolute evaluator path and relative contract path. A relocated replay wrapper must explicitly supply an equivalent location; this preservation does not claim such a replay occurred.
